name: Malaysian Nature Society (MNS)
summary: Promotes conservation of Malaysia's natural heritage through habitat and species protection, environmental education and policy advocacy.
programmes: Environmental education (Kelab Pencinta Alam, field trips)
Nature centres incl. Kuala Selangor Nature Park and MNS-BOH Field Study Centre
Raptor Watch and Pesta Sayap events
beneficiaries: Malaysian forests, wetlands, wildlife and birds; members, youth and the public

organisation.founders: A group of British expatriates (unnamed), linked to the first Malayan Nature Journal in 1940
organisation.leadership: President Anna Wong @ Wong Yun Moi; Vice Presidents Noor Jehan Abu Bakar and Ayadurai Letchumanan; Acting Executive Director Muhammad Raffi Bin Ismail (from July 2026); Board of Trustees Chair Puan Sri Datin Amar Nur Ashima Aziz

taxExemption.statement: Stated, no reference (tax-exempt receipts for donations of RM10 or more; no reference or validity printed)

organisation.accounts: Quarterly reports only (Q4 2024: https://mns.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/MNS-Q4-2024-Quarterly-Report.pdf); annual audited accounts not public

contact.address: JKR 641, Jalan Kelantan, Bukit Persekutuan, 50480 Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

live.note: YouTube channel linked from website (https://www.youtube.com/MNSmalaysia); no live streaming found
